name: CorBenchX
description: CorBenchX is a large-scale benchmark and dataset for automated error detection and correction in chest X-ray radiology reports. It includes 26,326 synthesized error reports paired with original texts and error annotations, and benchmarks vision-language models on detection and correction tasks under zero-shot prompting.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, but it is positioned as a specialized resource for radiology report error detection and correction.
notes: Synthesizes errors via prompting; evaluates multiple vision-language models; proposes reinforcement learning to improve correction.
